Deterministic binomial checks match asymptotics.

value.rationale: Determining sharp leading transport cost for natural iid lattice central-limit approximations distinguishes an unavoidable lattice quantization floor from distributional skewness, additively for quadratic cost and through a nontrivial convolution law for every other fixed order. This gives exact asymptotic quantities where current literature emphasizes optimal-order inequalities, with relevance to binomial Gaussian approximations.
